description: HR-33 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Safidon sub-division in the Jind district of Haryana. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the local jurisdiction.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Safidon, Jind, Haryana
